decisions.reason: The source defines checkout currency disclosure and customer selection behavior; it does not change Transak as the fiat provider, its USDC conversion, supported fiat methods, wallet provisioning, mint destination, or deferred lifecycle.
The direct USDC wallet-mint behavior remains valid unchanged. Settlement-currency display and multi-currency selection are independently owned by the source Requirement.
Checkout currency disclosure and selection do not alter the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The source changes how available settlement currencies are displayed or selected, not the mint price or allocation of mint revenue.
The optional gratuity's availability, placement, presets, and custom-amount behavior are unaffected by settlement-currency disclosure or selection.
The source mandates checkout UI behavior but does not request corresponding FAQ copy or revise any current FAQ topic.
Payment-currency presentation at checkout does not affect book-cover rendering on NFT detail pages.
The rule that only finalized successful mints are reported remains unchanged regardless of how checkout displays or selects settlement currency.
The source concerns primary-checkout currency selection and disclosure, not secondary-sale royalties, NFT standards, or marketplace enforcement.
Settlement-currency availability does not change referral eligibility or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The source does not alter the missing-or-rejected-referral trigger, commission amount, or random NFT-owner allocation.
Checkout currency disclosure and selection do not affect the randomness provider, draw applicability, fairness, or on-chain winner-selection behavior.
